summary:
Implemented rich_measure for Tree and added VerticalCenter. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, 4-cell indent per level, no max_width reduction) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, an Align width constraint (measured maximum, or min with explicit width), and VerticalCenter (render with newline-only padding from console.size.height, measurement delegation, repr, JupyterMixin). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options, leaving collection unchanged. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added subheading and two entries. Tests: test_align.py adds repr, VerticalCenter render (height 6 expects "

foo


"), and measurement (3/3) tests; test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Not verified: tests were not run, per instructions. Existing Align tests may be affected by the width constraint and should be checked when the suite runs. No commits made.
